title: Sun Dance and Moon Dance
author: Robert Cromartie
problems: Row 5 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 6 "long lines forward & back" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
Row 7 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 8 "pass through" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 2 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
Row 10 "neighbors do si do once" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 3 are too far apart to do-si-do.
Row 12 "larks balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing pairs a lark with a robin.
Row 13 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 15 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
The progression after row 8 "pass through" doesn't work out: No couples meet new neighbors here.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
